items.title: Five music tools run in this tab
items.body: Draw a spectrogram and export a WAV, write a piano roll and export real MIDI, or program a beat on the drum machine — no plugins, no account.

items.title: There is a terminal mode
items.body: Press the terminal icon in the header — or visit /terminal — and browse the whole site like a shell. Type "help" to see every command.

items.title: Every tool works offline
items.body: The calculators, converters, editors and games run entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, and most pages keep working with the network off.

items.title: Twelve games, zero installs
items.body: Snake, 2048, Pong, Block Defender, Neon Horizon and more — each one saves your best score in this browser only.

items.title: Markets in one screen
items.body: Coin Compass tracks crypto and market moves with plain-language context, so a red day is easier to read.

items.title: Measure your typing speed
items.body: The typing test scores words per minute and accuracy on real paragraphs, then shows which keys slow you down.

items.title: New: LayerShop, a Photoshop-style editor
items.body: Layers, blend modes, brushes, shapes, adjustments and PNG export — in a browser tab, with no upload and no account.
